title: QuadraticExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
description:
Restructure `gfpn::QuadraticExt::mul` for ILP and SoA-batched SIMD. The 3 base-field multiplications inside Karatsuba are independent and schedule onto SIMD lanes naturally once a SoA layout exists.

## Background

`gfpn::QuadraticExt::mul` in `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/quadratic.rs` does Karatsuba: 3 base-field multiplications and 2 additions per element. Scheduling is sequential and there is no SoA batched path despite the muls being independent.

The fix walks PPC steps:

- V2 ILP: schedule the 3 independent base-field muls across registers so they run in parallel (no false dependency chain). This step can ship before the generic Fp batch path lands.
- V3 SIMD batched: introduce a SoA `Vec<QuadraticExt<C>>` layout (separate `c0` and `c1` arrays); call into the generic Fp batch path for each Karatsuba step. Stronger gains here require the generic Fp batch task to have landed first.
- Wire the SoA scaffolding into a new `gfpn::compute` module.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Bit-exact vs. existing AoS `QuadraticExt::mul`.
- [hard] AoS path unchanged and at least as fast (no regression for callers that do not opt into SoA).
- [hard] SoA path covers add, sub, mul, square (all four ops, not just mul).
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact regenerated.
- [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded.
- [aspirational] $\geq 1.5\times$ geomean on `field_matrix_fusion` bench when both the generic Fp batch task and this task have landed.

## Notes

Bench: `field_matrix_fusion` (existing, pinned by I1). Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
